data: drive_master.csv (columns date, time_start, time_end, soc_start, soc_end, odo_start, odo_end); NOT tools/, tests/, compute_summary_arrays.py, analyses/M458_audit*
method_refs: analyses/M429_spec.md Rev 2 (cluster key, B, seed, percentile rule)

definitions.pairs: sort drives by (date, time_start); pair N -> N+1; gap_h = (start of N+1) - (end of N) in hours from date + time; draw_pp = soc_end(N) - soc_start(N+1); keep gap_h > 0
definitions.estimator: Sen slope = median of all pairwise slopes (y_j-y_i)/(x_j-x_i) over pairs with x_i != x_j; watts = slope/100 * 2100
definitions.interval: whole-cluster bootstrap, cluster = calendar day of the START of the following drive; B=4000; rng = numpy.random.default_rng(42); each draw: rng.choice(unique clusters, size=n_clusters, replace=True), concatenate all gaps of the drawn clusters (with multiplicity); percentile 2.5 / 97.5 (method linear) of the draw slopes; watts = slope/100*2100
definitions.iid_reference: fresh default_rng(42); idx = rng.integers(0, n, n) per draw

return: JSON <2 KB: AGREE/DISAGREE per claim with differences; tolerance 0.005 pp/h on slopes, 0.01 W on watts, 0.02 W on interval limits (generator-dependent: say which generator calls you used and whether the claimed interval reproduces exactly).
